title: Bounded repairs
summary: Target the failed block with its evidence and neighbors; reject edits to other IDs; recheck affected dependencies; at most two shared repair rounds in saved proposal.
body: Planned boundary: receives Localized findings; draft blocks; measured layout; produces Bounded block revisions or an unresolved issue. Owns Repair only the affected text or input. Must preserve: Do not regenerate unrelated blocks; stop after agreed repair bounds. Inspect actual code before claiming this boundary is already enforced.
change_reason: Refine module boundary and actual dependencies after Lohith's 2026-09-25 correction

contract.receives: Localized findings; draft blocks; measured layout
contract.produces: Bounded block revisions or an unresolved issue
contract.owns: Repair only the affected text or input
contract.must_preserve: Do not regenerate unrelated blocks; stop after agreed repair bounds
